# Restaurant Radar — Live Traveler Safe-Stop and Open Restaurant Radar (National and Global)
> Know what's open, well-lit, and family-safe before you pull off the highway. Restaurant Radar helps families, single parents driving at night, pet owners, and travelers with disabled family members find well-lit, secure gas stations, clean restrooms, fenced dog runs, ADA-accessible stops, and live open kitchens along their route so they can order ahead and save time.

## Platform Overview
- **Platform Name:** Restaurant Radar
- **Geographic Scope:** Launching from Southern Colorado across the United States and globally.
- **Official Website:** https://restaurantradar.app/
- **Agent / WebMCP Tool Manifest:** https://restaurantradar.app/api/tools.json
- **Sitemap:** https://restaurantradar.app/sitemap.xml
- **Core Traveler Features:** Midnight safe-stop lighting and security ratings, clean family bathroom reports, ADA/wheelchair accessibility, fenced dog runs, and live open-now restaurants for route-ahead ordering.

## Key Landing Pages and City Guides
- **Home and Live Open Radar:** https://restaurantradar.app/
- **City Operator License:** https://restaurantradar.app/city-license.html
- **Pueblo, CO Guide:** https://restaurantradar.app/best-restaurants-pueblo-co.html
- **Colorado Springs, CO Guide:** https://restaurantradar.app/best-restaurants-colorado-springs.html
- **Denver, CO Guide:** https://restaurantradar.app/best-restaurants-denver-co.html

## Verified Venue Membership and Licensing Tiers (USD)
- **Founding Professional Tier (First 10 Venues):** $9 / month (vs. $150-$600/month enterprise restaurant platforms)
- **Planned Verified Venue Tier:** $25 / month
- **Planned Featured Venue Tier:** $60 / month
